meta.ship_flags_rust: lane_gen.py compile_probe, rust branch: `opt = ["-C", "opt-level=1", "-C", "debug-assertions=off"]` then `["rustc", "--crate-type=lib", "--emit=obj"] + opt + ["-o", obj, src]` -- the ship build of every rust unit in the corpus
meta.ship_flags_swift: lane_gen.py compile_probe, swift branch: `opt = ["-Onone", "-g"] if mode == "anchor" else ["-O"]`; `cmd = [SWIFTC] + opt + ["-c", src, "-o", obj]` -- the ship build of every swift unit in the corpus
